Subject: AsterBio DPA request: scope split, SCCs, and TIA inputs

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for picking this up quickly. Attached is AsterBio’s starting DPA (we highlighted our expectations for processor-to-processor language and the subprocessor roster). High-level asks:

- Confirm whether Redwood will accept an Annex approach (DPA Annex + Order Form tie-in) or insists on a standalone DPA.
- We need explicit role mapping (controller/processor/subprocessor) for: user data, telemetry/observability, and model-derived outputs.
- Please confirm evidence we can receive for: encryption at rest, key management, and access logs (sample audit artifacts).
- SCCs: we propose SCCs + a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) for the non-EU subprocessors; please advise scope.

Timeline: procurement hopes to complete contract redlines by end of next week (2028-07-15). Can Redwood provide a redline and SCCs diff matrix by 2028-07-10?

Attaching: AsterBio_DPA_v1.pdf (our baseline)

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Legal Ops | AsterBio
[Attachment: AsterBio_DPA_v1.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-08T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio DPA request: scope split, SCCs, and TIA inputs

Marta — thanks, received. Short reply with proposed next steps and attachments.

1) Approach we recommend (pick one):
   - Option A (preferred for speed): DPA Annex that references Redwood’s Master DPA language + SCCs mapping sheet. Annex makes order form linkage straightforward for procurement.
   - Option B: standalone DPA with bespoke clauses if AsterBio needs full copy-editing of core clauses (longer turn).

2) Processor scope split: we’ll provide a table mapping the categories you listed (user data, telemetry, model outputs) to roles and subprocessors. This will include a clear statement that model hosting and runtime telemetry are processor functions; customer data classification sits with AsterBio as controller for end-user PII.

3) SCCs & TIA: we will produce an SCCs_DiffMatrix and a short TIA skeleton with mitigations (EU-only hosting, contractual mitigations, and technical controls). For non-EU subprocessors we recommend a combination of SCCs + documented compensating controls.

4) Evidence packet: security can prepare an evidence pack of sample artifacts (encryption config, KMS key policy snippet, audit-log sample, SOC 2 report reference). We’ll list what can be provided within 3 business days of your confirmation.

5) Timeline: we will deliver Redwood redline + SCCs_DiffMatrix by 2028-07-10 EOD (ETA). Laura will lead legal redlines; Olga will coordinate security evidence; Ben will map order-form tie-ins.

Action items:
- Marta: confirm Option A vs Option B and whether you require EU-hosted-only as a legal commitment or merely a mitigation option in the TIA.
- Redwood: produce redline and attachments by 2028-07-10.

Attaching: [Attachment: DPA_redline_v3.docx] (internal redline draft)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy & Trust | Redwood Inference
[Redwood Inference — internal]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AsterBio DPA request: scope split, SCCs, and TIA inputs

Karthik — quick legal notes on the redline before we send to AsterBio:

- Clause language: prefer "Subprocessor" definition to include both downstream hosting and ML ops vendors; explicitly call out model telemetry as a processing activity.
- Audit clause: push for a right to receive summary audit evidence and SOC 2 attestations; resist on-prem audits unless critical.
- Data deletion: propose 30 days for temporary data (logs, KV caches) and 90 days for backups unless otherwise requested.
- Breach notification: 72 hours initial notification + detailed follow-up within 10 business days.
- SCCs Annex: add Annex 1 mapping table that references the processor/processor-to-processor split — makes reviews faster.
- Order Form tie-in: require an Order Form appendix listing services and whether the workload is EU-hosted default. If client opts out, triggers TIA.

Please include these as tracked comments in the redline. I ran a quick pass and added a short SCCs_DiffMatrix highlighting where our standard SCCs require edits for the AsterBio setup. Security should confirm what evidence items are shareable.

Attaching: [Attachment: SCCs_DiffMatrix.xlsx]

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Karthik/Laura — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the materials.

We confirm Option A (DPA Annex + SCCs mapping). Two quick items:
- AsterBio procurement needs the Order Form appendix language by 2028-07-12 to stay on schedule. Please ensure Ben can draft the appendix language that states the default EU-hosted option and the fallback path (TIA).
- On evidence: we prefer the following subset to start with: SOC 2 summary, KMS key policy snippet, encryption-at-rest config, and a 7-day audit log extract (anonymized). Can Olivia/Olga confirm redaction approach?

We think a 30-minute working call would speed closure. Are you available 2028-07-11 at 09:00 BST / 02:00 PDT? If not, propose two alternatives and we’ll book.

Attaching for reference: [Attachment: TIA-draft.pdf]

Best,
Marta
